children: Greenwave Technology Solutions entered into two financing-related agreements to support liquidity. The company signed a Preferred Stock Purchase Agreement for a $3.75 million private placement of 3,750 shares of Series B Convertible Preferred Stock, initially convertible into about 715,649 common shares at $5.24 per share. Closing is expected on or about September 9, 2026, with proceeds for working capital. In a related move, Greenwave executed a Registration Rights Agreement requiring the timely filing and effectiveness of a registration statement to cover the conversion shares, enhancing potential liquidity for investors.
